_comment: Hand-kept overseas players: `uids` = players without a country registration who are known to live outside the region (players with a registration are judged from it, see country.py). `home_uids` = players registered elsewhere who should count as region players. `force_uids` = always overseas, whatever their registration or attendance (2026-10-17: Japanese top players who play more in Japan than here, chosen by the operator).
